Apple iOS 27 Mail App gets the upgrade I've been waiting years for: 'Search finally works'

iOS 27 dramatically improves Apple Mail search to deliver more relevant, accurate results

Apple's Mail app has long been plagued by poor search.

I suspect this statement would provoke zero disagreement among anyone who's used the app for any length of time. In fact, some might argue the word "poor" is being generous.

However, Apple says iOS 27 finally brings the search upgrades the Mail app deserves.

Here's what Apple's website says about the new feature in iOS 27:

Here's what this new mail ranking system means for you.

When you first open search in iOS 27's Mail app, you'll see a banner at the top that says "Expanded Search Results." It explains: "Mail can find more results based on what you're looking for, not just what you type."

Ultimately, Apple is bringing search into the 21st century. Or you could say it's just making search work the way it always should have.

I've been using the iOS 27 beta for a few months now, and in my experience, it's a definitive upgrade over the old system. Every time I've searched for something, I've found it. Of course, your mileage may vary.

The improved search relies on proper indexing, so if your iPhone is still building the index (you can check in Settings to see if it says "Optimizing Search & Siri"), you may need to wait before search is at its best.

What do you think of Apple Mail's search capabilities now? Have you tried iOS 27? Let me know in the comments.
